title: SME lender financial document readiness review

sources.text: Finance intake checklist: latest management accounts, twelve-month bank statements, tax status evidence, aged receivables, and current debt schedule.
2026 Q3 unaudited ZAR management accounts: revenue 850000; cost of sales 510000; current assets 1200000; current liabilities 800000.
Applicant statement: business account statements for July through September 2026 are attached; October statement is pending.
Applicant declaration: tax account is in good standing; current SARS status pin or official compliance evidence is not attached.
No aged receivables report, current debt schedule, October bank statement, or accountant-signed annual statements were supplied.

evidence.coverage_note: The requirement requests twelve-month bank statements. Confirm the required period and any further acceptable records with the responsible requirement owner.
